news.headline: Enviro Waste Services Group selects AMCS Wastedge to support operational excellence + scalable growth

paragraphs: AMCS Group sells software for companies that collect, haul and recycle waste. Its core product is a hosted platform that connects and automates an operator's entire waste and recycling business.

The platform reaches from customer management and transport optimization through to financial automation and business intelligence. A municipal edition extends the same approach from waste and recycling to street cleansing, winter maintenance and public area care. A residential edition covers customer onboarding, bin collection routing, in-field execution, billing and payments for household services.

The company states that more than 5,000 customers choose its products. Its fleet maintenance line reaches past waste into municipalities, road and public transportation, food and beverage, construction and utilities.

quote.text: Municipal waste management software helps cities plan, track, and optimise waste and recycling services by replacing manual processes with automated workflows and real-time visibility.
